scope: Local investigation only; no public changes or publication authorized.
candidate: benchmark/compatible-default.sh changes only MKL default AVX2 -> COMPATIBLE from the PR 11 shell script; explicit overrides retained.

method.timing: perf_counter around warmed compute calls, excluding interpreter/import/input generation; operator output allocation retained for PyTorch
method.pinning: distinct physical cores chosen within existing allowed CPU affinity; no system settings changed
method.order: randomized case/thread order per block using recorded deterministic seed
method.repeat_check: hash final output of each timed batch, 21 output samples per host/case/thread/workload
method.valid_outputs: Use each host commands.json to select actually executed cases; inherited AVX512 snapshots on non-AVX512 hosts are excluded.

limits: Native elapsed compute timings are rough workload-specific measurements; shared host load and output allocation contribute noise.
3-D convolution and some four-thread OpenBLAS/skinny results have substantial process-to-process spread; small differences are inconclusive.
Existing v2 Unity results used cpu053/EPYC 7763; new measurements use cpu033/EPYC 7543.
PyTorch 2.9.1+cpu includes MKL 2024.2 and oneDNN 3.7.1; separate ctypes MKL probes use 2025.2.0.
No GPU, backward/training or mixed-precision numerical coverage in this bounded study.
logs: Private per-host ~/.local/state/con-duct/reproseed-followup-20261004; no skill-log uploads under investigation-only scope.
